candidates.title: Master the Kettlebell Clean | Kettlebell Athletes
candidates.description:
Here is why kettlebell cleans are banging up your forearms & how to fix it! 👇🏼

We’ve been there too… tender wrists & bruised up forearms are no fun.

When first starting to use kettlebells there is a period of adaptation that needs to take place as your body gets used to the new stress of the kettlebell.

BUT amateur technique is what leads to persistent discomfort & bruising.

Mastering kettlebell technique will take your strength & performance to the next level!

Here is where to start 👇🏼

1️⃣ Keep the bell as close to your body as possible by pulling your elbow back and letting it ROLL around your wrist

This takes a lot of practice so be patient with yourself as you learn this new skill!

2️⃣ Dial up and down the power depending on the weight of the bell.

You are stronger than you think you are and probably don’t need to give that bell as much of a pop.

💰BONUS TIP: Film yourself and break the movement down to build it back up!

When you master kettlebell technique thats when your strength will skyrocket, you’ll move with more confidence, and your performance outside of the gym will go to the next level… the best part is, you can do it all from home.

We’ve taught thousands of athletes around the world how to go from amateur to Kettlebell Athlete.

If you are ready to finally feel like a badass with your bells & move with confidence this is what we do in the Kettlebell Athletes Membership.

Comment ATHLETE and we will help you find the perfect program to get started!

Sign up here!
https://www.kettlebellathletes.com/membership

#kettlebellathletes
